# Vim command reference

`index.txt` and `LICENSE` are unmodified upstream Vim v9.2.0000 files from
<https://github.com/vim/vim/tree/v9.2.0000>. Copyright and redistribution terms
are retained in `LICENSE`. KP's parser and coverage annotations are separate.

The index is a finite reference of built-in command forms, not every possible
count/operator/motion combination, plugin mapping, option or script function.
`npm run test:vim-coverage` checks its digest, extracted rows and coverage rules.
Updating this pinned reference requires reviewing parser changes and support
claims; installing a newer editor library must not silently check more boxes.
